tool_selection.reasoning: For tabular data, SHAP provides globally consistent and theoretically grounded feature attributions. LIME offers local interpretability that is non-parametric and model-agnostic. Integrated Gradients offers gradient-based importance with smoother attribution, and sensitivity analysis helps assess feature stability. Together, they provide a triangulated view of feature importance.
